input.title: Text Color button shifts downward when user selects any color
input.body:
## Step to Reproduce
1. Create a new thought
2. Tap Text Color button on the toolbar
3. Select any color



## Current behavior
Button shifts downward

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/01efd1ad-b832-46e3-8c4e-1a82f0140017

## Expected behavior
Button should not move
